name: As Above, So Below

angles.text: As a paladin, you see any hidden Scourge presence as an immediate peril. Investigating the reanimation magic beneath Shadowvale is a pressing duty.
As a priest trained against the unholy, you have reason to fear dark reanimation arts beneath an inhabited settlement.
As a mage, you can study the reanimation magic clinging to the glowing bones. It may reveal the necromantic methods used beneath the town.

aliases: what is as above so below
faq.answer: Hilda the Breaker sends an adventurer from Bandarion Keep into Shadowvale's cellars to investigate a hidden Scourge presence. The adventurer collects reanimated bone samples while trainees are drilled at the keep.
faq.q: What is As Above, So Below?

aliases: who gives as above so below
faq.answer: Hilda the Breaker instructs and prepares recruits at Bandarion Keep. She is tough and uncompromising, and demands results from those under her command. She would rather a recruit return on a stretcher than come back empty-handed.
faq.q: Who gives the quest As Above, So Below?

faq.answer: Shadowvale lies southwest of Bandarion Keep. The Tarnished cause trouble on the surface, while the town's cellars hold a greater danger.

aliases: what are the cellars below shadowvale
faq.answer: Reanimated undead gather in Shadowvale's cellars. If left unchecked, the hidden Scourge presence threatens Bandarion Keep with an uprising.
Hilda needs bones that retain the magic of their reanimation. By studying them, defenders hope to learn how the necromancy went unnoticed beneath the town.
faq.q: Why does Hilda need faintly glowing bones?

faq.answer: The Tarnished are a hostile faction active on Shadowvale's surface. Hilda sees the hidden Scourge beneath the town as the greater danger.
faq.q: Who are the Tarnished in Shadowvale?

sections.body: Hilda the Breaker prepares defenders at Bandarion Keep for the dangers around them. To the southwest, Shadowvale faces regular unrest from the Tarnished, a hostile faction. Yet beneath the town, the Scourge gathers strength in hidden cellars. If left unchecked, it may erupt in a sudden assault on the keep.
sections.title: The Hidden Threat

sections.body: Hilda sends seasoned adventurers into the cellars beneath Shadowvale for a direct lesson in the danger below. She will not send green trainees blindly into subterranean crypts. The aim is to gather intelligence by recovering skeletal remains that still hold reanimation magic. Those bones may show defenders how dark necromancy worked beneath their feet without being noticed.
sections.title: Magic in the Cellars

summary: At Bandarion Keep, Hilda the Breaker sends you to investigate the hidden Scourge beneath Shadowvale. Bones still humming with reanimation magic may reveal how the undead gathered beneath the town unseen.
attribution: In-game quest text: As Above, So Below
